comments: Primary submission is the free evaluation checker. Paid auto-tagging is separate; human screen-reader review still recommended after automation.
features: Free PDF accessibility checker that validates documents against PDF/UA (ISO 14289) using veraPDF. Reports structure/tag issues for Section 508, ADA, and EAA/EN 301 549. Browser-based; files processed in the EU and auto-deleted.
title: EasyAccessPDF
